*   `?g A4`: The main concept is "Fauna / Animal".
    *   `+ Black`: The animal is black (or has black in it).
    *   `+ White`: The animal is white (or has white in it).
    *   `+ E1`: The animal is associated with "Cold / Snow – Rain / Cloud".

    *   Main Concept: Animal.
    *   Colors: Black and White.
    *   Environment/Attribute: Cold, Snow, or Rain.

    *   Polar Bear (usually white, sometimes black nose/eyes, lives in snow).
    *   Penguin (Black and white, lives in cold/snow).
    *   Orca/Killer Whale (Black and white, lives in cold waters/snowy regions).
    *   Panda (Black and white, though usually associated with bamboo/forests rather than snow, though they live in mountain regions).
    *   Zebra (Black and white, but not "cold").
    *   Seal (Some are black/white, live in cold).
    *   Snow Leopard (Grey/White, usually).

    *   *Penguin* fits "Animal", "Black/White", and "Cold/Snow" perfectly.
    *   *Polar Bear* fits "Animal", "White" (but the black is just accents), and "Cold/Snow".
    *   *Orca* fits "Animal", "Black/White", and "Cold/Snow" (polar regions).

    *   Guess 1: Penguin
    *   Guess 2: Polar bear
    *   Guess 3: Orca
